# miniz

Unmodified amalgamated `miniz.c` and `miniz.h` from the official
[miniz 3.1.2 release](https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/releases/tag/3.1.2).
Release commit: `77d0dce8627735138c51770d1799a1ef48f2117d`.

Archive: `miniz-3.1.2.zip`, SHA-256
`f0446d863f9c19926ad9483c523fdc42e42b8d4a6a431d27e09d49c79a140d9a`.

The app compiles this through `src/MinizBridge.c` on every platform. Keep app
includes pointed here rather than the older copy inside the bimg submodule.
The upstream `LICENSE` is retained, and its readable text is shipped in
`assets/legal/miniz.txt`.
